alerts.name: Active orders at limit up/down (all markets)
alerts.description: For information: every working order, in any market, whose stock is at its daily limit (B-PIPE MIN_LIMIT / MAX_LIMIT) AND that is marketable at that limit. At the limit: best bid at the limit up, best ask at the limit down, or the last trade at either. Marketable: a market order (otype = market, or no limit price), a buy whose limit price is at or above the limit price the stock is stuck at, or a sell (short sells included) whose limit price is at or below it. Both sides count: an unfavourable limit can still be marketable. Checked every hour, 08:00-18:00 Hong Kong time; it notifies when an order joins or leaves the list. Markets without daily limits (no MIN_LIMIT / MAX_LIMIT from B-PIPE) never appear. The limits are asked once per stock per day, only for stocks new since the last check; bid, ask and last price at every check.

steps.name: orders
steps.note: Today's activated parents in every market, whatever their fixmsg, with sidesign (+1 buy, -1 sell), otype and limit_price for the marketable test; bbg = the Bloomberg ticker from the suffix (7203.JP -> 7203 JT Equity, 2330.TW -> 2330 TT Equity); lcr = the LCR field, if any
steps.raw_q: {[d] t:select date,id_server,id_target,sym,trader,side,sidesign,otype,limit_price,size,algo,fixmsg from target where date=d; ids:exec distinct id_target from t; s:select state:last state, leave:last leave by date,id_server,id_target from target_state where date=d, id_target in ids; r:select from (t lj s) where state=`activated; m:`TW`JP!`TT`JT; update bbg:{[m;s] p:"." vs string s; x:`$last p; x:x^m x; `$(first p)," ",(string x)," Equity"}[m] each sym, lcr:`${first x where x like "LCR=*"} each {raze "^" vs/: x} each ";" vs/: string fixmsg from r}[.z.D]

steps.name: limits
steps.note: Daily price limits: asked once per stock per day, only for stocks not seen yet today

steps.name: prices
steps.note: Live bid, ask and last trade, at every check

steps.name: at_limit
steps.note: Up: bid or last at MAX_LIMIT. Down: ask (above 0) or last at MIN_LIMIT. limit_px = the price the stock is stuck at. Kept only if marketable there: market order, buy priced at or above limit_px, sell priced at or below it

derive.expr: 'UP' if (BID >= MAX_LIMIT or LAST_PRICE >= MAX_LIMIT) else 'DOWN'

steps.where: (BID >= MAX_LIMIT or LAST_PRICE >= MAX_LIMIT or (ASK > 0 and ASK <= MIN_LIMIT) or LAST_PRICE <= MIN_LIMIT) and (otype == 'market' or isnull(limit_price) or limit_price <= 0 or (sidesign > 0 and limit_price >= limit_px) or (sidesign < 0 and limit_price <= limit_px))
